environment: Existing staging testnet, APAC Gateway pinned to Hong Kong, local Chromium in Tokyo
harness: Candidate site served from a local HTTPS server with Chromium host rules. No request interception, so the browser sends real CORS preflights.
limitations: Three new wallets per arm. Two runs. Sequential arms do not establish a latency guarantee.
Run A lost its third and fourth arm: the test evidence collector read a JSON body from the early OPTIONS responses. The three registrations of that arm completed on the server and are not counted.
Run B changes only the browser payload. Its early-preflight payload was built from public 490c3d50 plus an uncommitted patch.
Only NEAR signing was enabled. Implicit account registration and NEP-413 signing exclude funding and blockchain confirmation.
The client ran in Tokyo against a Gateway in Hong Kong. A client near the Gateway pays less for each exchange.
